storeCopy.seoTitle: Instagram Trending Reels Scraper | Video Feed
storeCopy.seoDescription: Get Instagram trending Reels with captions, likes, comments, author handles, and video links. Capture the current public feed and export ranked posts.
storeCopy.intro: Capture Instagram’s public trending Reels selection with captions, engagement counts, author handles, and video links. Each run records a current snapshot of the global feed.
useCases: Social teams can review currently surfaced public Reels for creative patterns.
Researchers can archive trending captions, creators, and engagement counts.
Content strategists can compare trending video topics across repeated runs.
howToUse: Keep one `trending` entry in `feeds` to request the global feed.
Set `maxResults` to cap the number of Reel rows saved.
Schedule repeated runs if you want to compare public feed snapshots.

faqs.question: Can I choose a country or hashtag?
faqs.answer: No. This source feed returns the global trending selection and does not accept a region or search phrase.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Instagram media identifier for the trending Reel.

fields.name: shortcode
fields.description: Short code used in the public Reel URL.

fields.name: media_type
fields.description: Instagram format label for this trending item.

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Caption text displayed with the Reel.

fields.name: taken_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 time when the Reel was posted, when reported.

fields.name: taken_at_timestamp
fields.description: Unix timestamp when the Reel was posted.

fields.name: like_count
fields.description: Number of likes reported for the Reel.

fields.name: comment_count
fields.description: Number of comments reported for the Reel.

fields.name: play_count
fields.description: Number of video plays reported for the Reel, when available.

fields.name: has_audio
fields.description: True when Instagram reports audio on the Reel.

fields.name: video_url
fields.description: URL of the Reel video asset, when available.

fields.name: thumbnail_url
fields.description: URL of the Reel preview image.

fields.name: author
fields.description: Public profile details for the account that posted the Reel.

fields.name: permalink
fields.description: Public Instagram URL for the Reel.

fields.name: author_id
fields.description: Instagram identifier for the posting account.

fields.name: author_username
fields.description: Public Instagram handle of the posting account.

fields.name: author_verified
fields.description: True when Instagram marks the posting account as verified.

fields.name: input_feed
fields.description: Fixed feed label used to identify this global trending snapshot.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC date and time when this record was collected.
